message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by a weekend, or a holiday that falls on a weekend and is observed on the nearest weekday.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the public holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Family Day is always on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Observed on Monday Nov 13 because the day itself fell on Saturday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas Day fell on Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |

### Quick‑look calendar

```
2023 Long Weekends (Canada)

Jan 1–3  New Year’s Day
Feb 18–20 Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.)
Apr 7–9  Good Friday
May 20–22 Victoria Day
Jul 1–3  Canada Day
Sep 2–4  Labour Day
Oct 7–9  Thanksgiving
Nov 11–13 Remembrance Day
Dec 23–25 Christmas
```

> **Pro‑Tip:**  
> Some provinces have additional holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Newfoundland & Labrador, **St. John’s Day** in New Brunswick, **St. George’s Day** in Prince Edward Island, **St. Patrick’s Day** in Manitoba, etc.). If you’re targeting a specific province, double‑check its holiday calendar for those extra dates.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like a more detailed, province‑specific version!
